title: Tenant Sidecar Eval Sentinel with Client-side Redaction and Local Staging Gate
creator: Aisha Mendez
description: Problem: Customers running Redwood Dedicated/Private want deterministic, pre-release quality checks for model/config changes that never send raw prompts or outputs to Redwood control plane. Goal: build a 'sidecar eval sentinel' that runs tenant-scoped eval suites in-customer (sidecar or on-prem runner), performs client-side redaction and hashing, stores goldens locally, and only returns small signed rollup artifacts (hashed diffs, pass/fail signals, and telemetry flags) to the control plane for gating deploys. This ticket covers product definition, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for the MVP sidecar runner and the minimal control-plane gates needed for canary/rollout automation.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar binary that can be deployed alongside Private/VPC workloads or installed as a per-tenant sidecar in Dedicated pools
Config-driven eval manifest format (YAML) that maps model/config change triggers to eval suites and thresholds
Client-side redaction pipeline: PII token pattern removal, configurable field-level allowlist/denylist, and deterministic hashing of preserved context
Local goldens storage with versioned manifests; no raw outputs leave customer environment by default
Control-plane receives only: signed summary (hashes of outputs), pass/fail binary for each probe, and telemetry metadata (latency, sample counts) — no raw text
Integration test that simulates a model rollback gate triggered by a sidecar fail signal in a staging environment
Security review completed and KMS/HSM key flow documented for signing summaries
Documentation and quickstart for customers to author eval manifests and opt in to sending more granular telemetry under explicit consent
